headline: Top two draw and Roosevelt stay unbeaten
dek: The leaders met the side directly beneath them in the table and shared the points at Roosevelt. Roosevelt have now drawn five matches and won six, and remain the only side in the conference without a defeat.
displaced_by: Roosevelt drew with Northern Michigan on 2026-09-25: a fifth draw, so the standing 'fourth draw' headline is no longer true, and the meeting of the table's top two is the day's news.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring is top-heavy: Northern Michigan alone have scored more than Purdue Northwest and St. Cloud State together.

wire.line: Wisconsin-Parkside are the only side in the conference yet to draw a match.

findings.label: observed

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Roosevelt's six wins are more than any other programme has managed.

next_match.line: St. Cloud State are yet to win in conference play; Northern Michigan arrive as the conference's top scorers.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
